subject: Lumina AI — pricing sanity check & founder credit request
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumina.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 17:08:00 -0800
Subject: Lumina AI — pricing sanity check & founder credit request

Hi Oliver — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the concrete asks so we have alignment before I loop in pricing: 

Call recap
- Primary workload: multi-turn chat summarization + embeddings for search.
- Expected steady-state: ~120M tokens/month in months 3–6 (bursting to ~220M in month 6 with batch inference).
- Profile: 60% gen tokens, 40% embeddings/encoding.
- Latency SLO: 200–300ms P95 for chat, embeddings can be async.

Budget and ask (from Lumina)
- Target effective unit economics: ~$700–$950 per 1M tokens (goal is to hit ~$800 if possible).
- Initial go‑to‑prod budget: ~$50–65k/month for first 3 months.
- Procurement timeline: aiming for a contract signed before end of March.
- Requests on the table: founder / startup credit to offset onboarding, and a committed-use discount for a 12-month minimum (potential to expand to multi-year if economics are right).

What I’m proposing we document for pricing:
- Founder credit: one-time $10k credit applied to first invoice.
- Intro committed tier: 12-month minimum, 100M tokens/month commit, blended discounted rate target $/1M = $600–$700 (rough target based on their $/1M goal).
- Multi-year incentive: additional 15–25% off committed rate for 24-month or larger financial commitments.

Next steps
1) Oliver confirms the monthly token baseline and procurement constraints (PO needed, SOC2 evidence required).
2) We send a draft term sheet + pricing matrix (attached: lumina-usage-estimate.csv).
3) Internal: Ben/Monica — can you review proposed ranges and suggest the best play to get to a win while protecting margin?

Attachments: lumina-usage-estimate.csv (token build / month)

Thanks — happy to hop on another 20m if helpful.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumina.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumina AI — pricing sanity check & founder credit request

Thanks Camila — good summary and sorry for the later note (UTC conversion). A few clarifications from my side: 

- Token baseline: the 120M/month steady-state is correct as the conservative projection. We have runway to stretch to 200–250M/month if the onboarding is painless.
- Budget: $55k/month is what finance has penciled in for Q2 starter usage; we can stretch to $70k if there’s a strong commit discount and onboarding credit.
- Procurement: we need a standard PO and a short SOW. SOC 2 Type II evidence is required before production access.
- Timeline: our legal procurement window opens 3/1; target to have commercial terms agreed by 3/22 to fit our Q2 forecast.

On discounts: founder credit is very helpful — $10k sounds reasonable. For committed discounts, can you outline the breakpoints you usually support (e.g., 100M, 250M, 500M monthly commit) and the typical $/1M at each breakpoint? That will help our CFO evaluate.

I’ll loop in accounts-payable once we get a formal quote.

—Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Product
Lumina AI
oliver@lumina.ai | +1 646-555-0983
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Lumina AI — pricing sanity check & founder credit request

Forwarding Oliver's reply — he confirmed baseline + asks and needs the breakpoints for CFO review.

Internal notes (Camila -> Ben/Monica):
- Lumina is an interesting product-led startup with clear expansion potential; procurement is conservative but flexible with clear financial incentives.
- Proposed initial play (please advise):
  * Breakpoint A (starter): 50M–120M tokens/month commit -> list $/1M = $1,200; committed price target = $750 ($37.5–$90k/month depending on usage).
  * Breakpoint B (growth): 120M–300M tokens/month commit -> list $/1M = $1,000; committed price target = $600 ($72–$180k/month).
  * Breakpoint C (scale): 300M+ tokens/month -> list $/1M = $850; committed price target = $520.
- Founder credit: $10k on first invoice to reduce friction.
- Multi-year incentive: additional 15% off committed price when they commit 24 months or prepay 12 months.
- Non-negotiables: SOC2 before production, standard data handling terms, and a three-month mutual exit window for early-stage startups.

Attachments to include in the quote pack: pricing-matrix-q1-2026.pdf, redwood-startup-terms-draft.docx (I attached both). Also attaching their usage estimate.

Ask: Ben — can you confirm margin at the proposed committed price targets and whether we should tighten any of these bands? Monica — any suggestions on legal clauses to fast-track (PO + short SOW template)?

—Camila
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumina AI — pricing sanity check & founder credit request

Thanks Camila — solid summary. Quick responses and recommended approach: 

1) Margin check: the committed price targets look okay with these stipulations:
   - Breakpoint A ($750/1M) -> ~32% gross margin assuming current hosting mix.
   - Breakpoint B ($600/1M) -> ~45% gross margin (healthy; this is the sweet spot to push them toward).
   - Breakpoint C ($520/1M) -> ~38% gross margin but requires tighter latency SLO acceptance and possible quantized model variant.

2) Negotiation playbook:
   - Offer founder credit $10k and a 12-month committed starter at Breakpoint B pricing if they sign by 3/22.
   - If they want 24 months, add 15% multi-year incentive on top of Breakpoint B (blended to ~$510/1M).
   - Require SOC2 evidence and a PO + short SOW. Offer 30 days to produce those items; otherwise revert to list pricing.

3) Legal / onboarding: Monica — we should push the short SOW + onboarding checklist as the path to production; I'll attach a condensed onboarding credit (10 hours engineering support).

I attached an updated pricing-matrix (pricing-matrix-q1-2026.pdf) and a draft startup terms doc (redwood-startup-terms-draft.docx) for Camila to send to Oliver.

Play to win: push them to Breakpoint B with a clear ROI: show $/1M blended and expected monthly invoices with the founder credit applied to month one.

—Ben
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: pricing-matrix-q1-2026.pdf, redwood-startup-terms-draft.docx
